title: Vikram and Betal: The Greedy Judge

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a greedy judge.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a judge who was greedy.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: Two men came to the judge with a land dispute.
scenes.image_prompt: two men arguing over land in court cartoon

scenes.text: The judge secretly took money from one man.

scenes.summary: The truth is reported to the king.
scenes.text: The other man told the king about the unfair decision.
The king removed the judge for being dishonest. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: king removing judge while betal flies away cartoon

story: A greedy judge took a bribe and gave an unfair decision. The truth reached the king, who punished the judge. Vikram said greed leads to injustice, and Betal flew away.
